title: Cascade routing decision graph and preflight cache-validation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Add a deterministic cascade routing decision graph that selects regions and tiers based on live capacity, latency telemetry, and readiness scoring, plus a preflight cache-validation harness that runs lightweight warm-cache probes against standby fleets before cutover. The goal is to reduce failed cross-region cutovers and cold-start latencies by verifying both routing heuristics and the integrity/warmth of KV caches and model artifacts before activation.
acceptance_criteria: New decision graph service returns ranked region+tier candidates within 50ms for 99th percentile of real traffic patterns
Preflight harness can validate KV cache hit-rate and model artifact checksums for a candidate standby within a configurable time budget (default 5s)
Failover activation only proceeds when readiness score >= configured threshold and preflight probe passes; otherwise fallback variant routing is used
End-to-end simulated cutover test demonstrates <= 2x latency increase for first 5s after activation and no dropped requests at the origin tier
Observability: dashboards for readiness_score, probe_latency, prefetched_kv_hit_rate, and failover_activation_time are present and populated in staging
design_notes: Decision graph: implement as a small stateful service that consumes regional health, capacity inventory, and recent latency histograms and outputs a ranked list with reasons
Readiness scoring: combine binary checks (artifact checksums/KV integrity) with continuous signals (recent tail latency, error rate) into a single 0-100 score
Prefetch probes: lightweight inference request shapes (short prompts) that exercise KV lookups + model warm path to measure effective cache warmth and cold-start debt
Cost trade-offs: probes add bandwidth and GPU cycles to standby fleets — make probes adaptive (quota per standby per hour) and allow sampled smoke-probes during high-pressure windows

Fallback model variants: when readiness fails, router should automatically prefer a compatible lower-capacity variant (quantized/shorter-context) with documented quality deltas and a mandatory alert to SRE/owner
implementation_plan: Phase 1: API contract and decision-graph library (2w) — proto: /rank-candidates(region_set, request_profile) -> ranked list
Phase 2: Preflight probe runner integrated with health agent (2w) — implement probe scheduling, timeout, and result aggregation
Phase 3: Router integration and feature flag path (1w) — implement gating logic that calls decision graph and probe runner prior to region handoff
Phase 4: Canary rollout and chaos experiments (2w) — run controlled cutovers in staging and canary region, inject partial failures
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring functions, including synthetic inputs that stress edge cases (e.g., stale telemetry, transient API failures)
Integration tests: end-to-end cutover sim that runs decision graph + probes against a simulated fleet with controllable cache warmth
Load test: ensure /rank-candidates scales to 500 req/s with <50ms p99 under CPU-bound conditions
Chaos tests: simulate region blackout and verify router picks fallback variant and ramps per rollout policy
Regression checks: perf benchmarks to ensure probe runner overhead on standby fleet < 3% of serving capacity
rollout_plan: Start behind feature flag in staging; validate metrics for 48h
Enable for single low-traffic customer on production Dedicated region for 24h
Gradual ramp: expand to 10% of cross-region handoffs, monitor failover_success_rate and customer latencies
Full rollout contingent on zero critical regressions in 7-day window and SRE signoff
Fallback: ability to disable preflight probe gating and revert to previous routing policy immediately via runtime flag
telemetry_requirements: readiness_score (gauge) per standby (tags: region, tier, model_variant)
comments: 2026-03-11: Spike complete — initial probe harness prototype warms KV cache and returns hit-rate metric. Observed ~12% GPU overhead when probes run every minute; moving to adaptive sampling.
2026-03-12: PM feedback — require explicit SLO mapping from readiness_score -> allowed ramp rates. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-13: SRE review — want an emergency bypass that disables preflight gating; adding a runtime flag and verifying rollback plan.
2026-03-14: Implementation started — created decision-graph service skeleton and proto. Andre pairing with infra to allocate small Fargate pool for initial canary.
